verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We establish a link between free probability theory and Witt vectors, via the theory of formal groups. verdicts.title: Analytic continuations of Fourier and Stieltjes transforms and generalized moments of probability measures
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider analytic continuations of Fourier transforms and Stieltjes transforms. This enables us to define what we call complex moments for some class of probability measures which do not have moments in the usual sense.
